subject: High School Building Project Schematic Design
overview: The committee approved contract amendments for specialty design services and reviewed positive feedback from the MSBA regarding the building's educational plan. Members also discussed the inclusion of a Teen Health Center and examined detailed space requirements for medical and guidance suites.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from June 2026.

items.title: Approval of Invoices
items.summary: Approved June 2026 invoices for Left Field and SMMA totaling $155,375.

items.title: SMMA Amendment for Specialty Consulting
items.summary: Approved an amendment for geothermal, solar, and pool consulting services, excluding a $9,000 task for a new pool basin pending further committee discussion.

items.title: MSBA Facilities Assessment Subcommittee Update
items.summary: Received a report on the positive MSBA subcommittee feedback regarding the project’s educational plan, site topography management, and architectural design.

items.title: Teen Health Center Inclusion
items.summary: Discussed the School Committee’s decision to include a non-reimbursable Teen Health Center in the high school design to provide on-site medical and mental health services.

items.title: Space Summary Walkthrough
items.summary: Reviewed spatial requirements and MSBA guideline variations for the building's medical suite, counseling offices, and custodial maintenance areas.

items.title: Schematic Design Phase Timeline
items.summary: Outlined the Module 4 schedule, which includes final budget development in December and a planned city-wide vote in June 2027.

items.title: Educational Plan Website Access
items.summary: Approved a motion to ensure the most recent revision of the project’s educational plan is explicitly linked on the building project website.
